description: Create a home brewing log spreadsheet. Add headers for: Batch Name, Brew Date, Style, Original Gravity (OG), Final Gravity (FG), ABV (%), Batch Size (bottles), Total Cost ($), Cost/Bottle ($), Rating (out of 5). Enter data for 4 brewing batches with formulas to calculate ABV using (OG-FG)*131.25 and Cost/Bottle using Total Cost / Batch Size. Apply conditional formatting to highlight ratings >= 4. Add summary statistics: Average ABV, Total Spent, and count of Successful Batches (rating >= 4). Save as brewing_log.xlsx in /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/
